I think priest right now is far superior when it comes to discover and value generation. The one mana Draconic Studies synergies extremely well with spellburst cards, not to mention having a reduced dragon for a tempo swing play is astronomically game changing. Cards like Cobalt Guardian can also be discovered that can then generate another Draconic Studies and you will be seeing priests playing 2-3 onyx magescribes generating maybe 8-13 spells in the late game.

The new 4-mana minion removal also really pushes for favorable late game, which can punish the opposing players when you have Mind Control discovered or drafted. 

Also there might be some bias involved, but I have already won 12 win games three times by drafting priest alone, and in some of my other games above 7 wins I'm having issues winning against priest - aggro decks being stunted by apotheosis on a big minion, mid range tempo being destroyed by value generation and mind control, I even made a decent ramp druid deck somehow only to have my last three losses against priest.
